data.business_sentiment:
CMA is a 15-year-old legacy claims handling platform that is increasingly constraining the business and introducing operational risk. While the platform is stable and highly configurable—primarily in the invoicing space—it performs poorly as a modern case management system. As a result, Adjuster Hub within the Complex Loss Ecosystem is positioned as its strategic replacement for case management.

CMA suffers from several critical operational shortcomings, including an outdated proxy model, inflexible rates management, limited document management, and an absence of workflow automation. Core processes remain heavily manual, with significant rekeying and slow case creation and management, driving inefficiency and user frustration.

Data quality is a major issue. The system relies on unintuitive custom fields, making it difficult to capture business-line-specific data consistently. Reporting is further constrained by limited client-facing MI, reducing adjuster incentive to maintain accurate data. As a result, a significant proportion of users continue to record time in CMA or offline tools rather than the strategic Adjuster Hub platform, perpetuating fragmentation and inconsistency.
